description: This file defines a Java class that serves as a command handler for updating office information within the Fineract system. It processes commands to update office data by delegating to the OfficeWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateOfficeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for Office entities by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, leveraging dependency injection for the OfficeWritePlatformService, and executing within a transaction.

methods.name: UpdateOfficeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor for the handler, injecting the OfficeWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes an update command for an office by delegating to the write platform service to perform the update.
